app.name: Civil Resilience App
app.tagline: Get your household ready, one badge at a time.

home.todoEmpty: Start a badge and your checklist appears here.
home.attentionHint: Some supplies are past their check-by date. Refresh them to restore the badge.

badge.questionsKnown: We already know most of what we need. {{count}} quick questions.
badge.questionsNone: We already know everything we need.
badge.stub: This badge is still being written. The items below are the core actions; more will follow in an update.
badge.quantityHint: Enter what you actually have. It is fine to be below the target for now.

survey.required: This one is needed for the badge.
survey.sensitive: Stays on this device. Never sent anywhere.
survey.confirmHint: Tap anything that is out of date.

profile.title: Profile
profile.privacy: This stays on your phone. We never receive it.
profile.privacyLong: Everything you enter is stored only in this browser on this device. There is no account, no server and no analytics. If you clear the site data or lose the device, the data is gone - use Export to keep a backup.
profile.notUsed: Not used by any badge yet
profile.empty: Nothing here yet. Badges fill this in as you go.
profile.deleteConfirm: Delete all your data from this device? This cannot be undone.
profile.importError: That file is not a backup from this app.
profile.myPlanHint: Everything your household needs to know, on one screen. Screenshot it or print it.

now.title: Right now
now.subtitle: Something is happening. Pick what.
now.noInfo: Complete badges to see your shelter, meeting point and kit location here.

shelters.title: Shelters and covers
shelters.subtitle: Nearest first. Pin the one you would actually walk to.
shelters.denied: Location was refused. You can still browse the list and search by town.
shelters.sample: Sample data - the official dataset is not connected yet.
shelters.refreshFailed: Could not refresh. Showing the saved copy.
shelters.mapOffline: Map tiles need internet. The list works offline.
shelters.locationNote: Your location is used once to sort the list. It is not stored or sent.

about.title: About
about.what: Official civil-protection guidance, turned into a checklist sized to your household. Free, open source, no account.
about.sourcesHint: Every item cites where the advice comes from.
about.shareHint: Scan to open on another phone.
about.fundingText: Right now: nobody. This is a volunteer project. Recommended items may later carry links to shops where a small commission supports the project. You never need to buy from those links - any equivalent item counts.

onboarding.title: Three days on your own.
onboarding.body: Storms, blackouts, worse. Officials ask every household to cope for 72 hours without help. Most cannot. This app gets you there, one badge at a time.
onboarding.privacy: Everything you enter stays on this phone. No account, no server, no tracking.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: It works best installed on your phone, like a regular app.

why.offline: Works with no internet, even when the network is down.
why.homescreen: Opens from your home screen in one tap.
why.noStore: No app store, no account, a few megabytes.

install.aboutHint: The installed app works offline and opens from your home screen.

ios.share: In Safari, tap Share at the bottom (the square with an arrow).
ios.confirm: Tap Add. The app appears with your other apps.

install.manual: In your browser menu choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".

celebrate.first_item: First item done. That is how it starts.
celebrate.all_live: Every badge earned. Your household is ready.
